coordinate_convention.normalized: x: 0 left -> 1 right; y: 0 top -> 1 bottom
coordinate_convention.roi_format: Axis-aligned pixel-edge bounds normalized by viewport width and height; maximum image-edge bounds may equal 1.
coordinate_convention.center_policy: Preserve center_norm and center_px exactly, including original rounding differences. Seeds need not equal ROI midpoints.

measurement_method.inspection_source: Exact 941 x 1672 target attached in the user message; local view_image decoder returned unsupported image data.
measurement_method.measurement: Manual visual readings of enclosing pixel-edge ROIs on the attached target followed by normalization; no segmentation or final gate scoring.
measurement_method.roi_scope: Discrete objects use visible extents. Terrain, water and junction regions describe composition; bounding rectangles may contain occluders and adjacent material and are not masks. Diffuse shadows excluded for UI and props.
measurement_method.precision_note: Pixel bounds are approximate visual readings. Six-decimal normalization is arithmetic precision, not subpixel measurement accuracy.
measurement_method.center_refinement: No center refinement in T016; anchor semantics document retained T015 seeds.

depth_intent_semantics.foreground: Near camera: main bridge, lower banks, pools, footing and lower channel.
depth_intent_semantics.midground: Player, junction, diagonal bridge, middle meadow and central conifers.
depth_intent_semantics.background: Upper path, left forest/cliff framing mass and upper water/cascade.
depth_intent_semantics.ui: Screen-space overlay independent of scene depth.
depth_intent_semantics.note: Qualitative dominant composition layer, not metric distance or final occlusion-order validation; large regions may span multiple depths.
